title: Consolidate Sketchpad Source Files Into Sketchpad.tsx
description: Consolidate all non-config files in compose/sketchpad/sketchpad/ into Sketchpad.tsx, organized with proper regions/sections: Apps > Design, Type, Kit, Quality, Home, Docs, Feedback, Tutorials, plus shared utilities like portColor, kitSelectionHelper, kitSelectionHelpers, shared. Update all external imports. Remove old files. Ensure tests pass.
summary: Consolidated all 12 non-config source files (shared.ts, portColor.ts, Tutorials.tsx, Design.tsx, Type.tsx, Kit.tsx, kitSelectionHelper.ts, kitSelectionHelpers.ts, Quality.tsx, Docs.tsx, Home.tsx, Feedback.tsx) into a single Sketchpad.tsx file (~49k lines) organized with proper #region sections: Shared, PortColor, Tutorials, SketchpadCore, Apps (Design, Type, KitSelectionHelper, Kit, Quality, Docs, Home, Feedback). Applied symbol renames to avoid conflicts (designConfig, typeConfig, kitConfig, qualityConfig, docsConfig, homeConfig, feedbackConfig; DesignAppInner, TypeAppInner, KitAppInner, QualityAppInner, DocsAppInner; etc.). Replaced dynamic imports (SketchpadStore._loadModules, loadAppConfigs) with direct references since all modules are now in the same file. Removed stale export type from ./shared. Deleted all 12 original source files. Updated index.ts and apps/index.ts imports. Build passes for compose/sketchpad and downstream consumers (compose/sites/play).
